Welcome to
Kinnitty Castle Hotel
Step Into a World Apart
Set within 650 acres of private parkland at the foothills of the Slieve Bloom Mountains, Kinnitty Castle is a destination where history, beauty and atmosphere intertwine. As you follow the winding avenue through ancient woodland, the silhouette of a 13th-century castle slowly reveals itself. Timeless, majestic and quietly unforgettable.
Here, more than 800 years of stories live within the stone walls.
Built in 1209 and lovingly restored in medieval revival style, the castle is a sanctuary of heritage and understated luxury, where every archway, window and corridor whispers of another era.
This is not simply a stay.
It is an experience of time, place, and feeling.
A Stay Steeped in Character
Each of our 37 individually designed guest rooms offers a unique expression of the castle's charm. From the historic main castle to our newly refined Abbey Wing, interiors blend classic elegance with contemporary comfort.
Expect rich fabrics, curated furnishings, and a sense of quiet indulgence that invites you to slow down and savour the moment. Wake to views of ancient trees and sweeping lawns. Wander peaceful hallways where history lingers softly in the background. Sink into the stillness of a place untouched by the rush of modern life.
Whether for romance, celebration, or pure escape, a stay at Kinnitty Castle is one that lingers in memory long after departure.
Dining That Tells a Story
Dining at Kinnitty is woven into the spirit of the castle itself atmospheric, intimate and deeply rooted in place.
From the warm elegance of the Library Bar, where you can enjoy one of our signature cocktails, to the atmospheric charm of the Dungeon Bar each space offers its own distinctive mood. Our newly refreshed Dungeon menu brings together a selection of delicious dishes, making it the perfect place to relax, dine and enjoy the unique character of Kinnitty Castle.
Leading our culinary vision is award-winning Head Chef James Dever, whose passion for exceptional Irish produce shines through every menu. His approach honours the land and seasons, combining creativity with authenticity to deliver dishes that are both refined and deeply comforting.
Whether enjoying afternoon tea, a celebratory dinner or a glass of wine in storied surroundings, dining here is always an occasion
Space to Breathe, Time to Wander
Beyond the castle doors lies a world of quiet discovery.
Stroll woodland paths across the estate, explore the untouched beauty of the Slieve Bloom Mountains, or uncover the heritage of Ireland's Hidden Heartlands. From outdoor pursuits to gentle countryside moments, the pace here is entirely your own.
And for those who prefer to simply be the castle itself offers sanctuary.
A place to read by tall windows, linger over conversation and rediscover the luxury of unhurried time.
Weddings Woven in Magic
Where Forever Begins
Few places lend themselves to romance quite like a castle.
At Kinnitty, centuries of history provide the perfect backdrop for life's most meaningful moments. Exchange vows beneath ancient stone, celebrate beneath chandeliers and capture memories across acres of private parkland.
Our dedicated wedding team ensures every celebration is seamless, personal and deeply unforgettable whether an intimate gathering or a grand affair.
Here, your story becomes part of the castle's story.
More Than a Stay, a Feeling...
Kinnitty Castle is not defined by luxury alone, but by atmosphere by the sense of stepping into somewhere rare and meaningful.
It is in the stillness of the grounds at dusk.
The warmth of genuine Irish hospitality.
The feeling of discovering somewhere truly different.
Come for the beauty.
Stay for the experience.
Leave with a story that will stay with you forever.

Accommodation at Kinnitty Castle
Step into the timeless charm of Kinnitty Castle Hotel and experience one of Ireland's most distinctive castle stays. Nestled within the historic Castle are 37 individually designed en-suite guest rooms, each offering its own unique character and style. Spacious layouts, high ceilings, luxurious fabrics, and carefully selected period furnishings combine to reflect the rich heritage and elegance of this remarkable property.
Guests can choose from four categories of accommodation: Abbey Court Rooms , Baronial Rooms , State Rooms, and Castle Suites . Every bedroom has been thoughtfully named after historic figures and places connected to the Castle's enduring story, creating a truly authentic and memorable experience.
No two rooms are alike. Many of the Castle's original features have been carefully preserved, and even the room keys retain a sense of old-world charm. Each space offers a unique blend of historic character and modern comfort, complemented by the warmth and hospitality for which Ireland is renowned.
At Kinnitty Castle Hotel, exceptional service is part of the Castle's tradition. Many members of our team are second-generation Castle staff, proudly continuing a long-standing legacy of hospitality and ensuring every guest enjoys a welcoming and memorable stay.
To enhance your comfort, each room includes a selection of premium toiletries, and our 24-hour reception team is available throughout your stay to assist with any requirements.
Guests requiring further information or assistance are encouraged to contact our Reception Team today:
reception@kinnittycastlehotel.com.
+353 (57) 9137318
Please note : Due to the historic age, design and structure of Kinnitty Castle, the property does not have an elevator and all guest rooms are located across split-level floors.
